$description: TripUp's Figma components, documented for people and agents. Hand-written: what, use, avoid, props, code, story. From the Figma file: section (the component's section on the Components page), id (node id), key (component key), figmaProps (the component's property API). Build COMPONENTS.md with: node design-system/build-components-doc.mjs

categories.name: Buttons
categories.about: The raised bodies people tap. Soft for most actions, primary (brand blue) for the one main action on a screen.

components.name: Button
components.what: Round icon button: every icon-only action in TripUp (back, close, add, the arrow into a trip).
components.use: When the icon alone says the action. Kind=primary only for the one main action on a screen. States: Kind=soft|primary × Size=sm|md|lg, all six. Pressed has no look of its own: the whole button scales to 0.97 (press-scale) while held.
components.avoid: Actions that need words: use Text button.
components.props: Kind → kind (GlassKind.soft | primary) · Size → size (TuButtonSize sm 40 | md 44 | lg 56) · Icon → icon (a TuIcons entry). Code also takes label (read by screen readers) and onTap.

components.name: Text button
components.what: Pill button with a label and an optional icon before it, for actions an icon can't say: Pay, Copy link, Send to the group.
components.use: Set the instance's width to Fill for the main action at the bottom of a page (wide: true in code). States: Kind=soft|primary × Size=sm|md|lg, with or without the icon, hugging its label or set to Fill. Pressed has no look of its own: the whole button scales to 0.97 (press-scale) while held.
components.props: Label → label · Show icon + Icon → icon (null hides it) · Kind → kind (code default is primary) · Size → size · Fill width → wide: true.
components.figmaProps: Label (text), Show icon (boolean), Icon (instance swap), Kind=soft|primary, Size=sm|md|lg

components.name: Add button
components.what: Small round toggle on a menu row: a plus in soft glass, a check in primary glass once the dish is added. One tap toggles it.
components.use: Only on Menu row. The 32 circle sits in a 44 touch target.
components.props: Added=no|yes → added. Code also takes itemName (for the screen reader: Add … to your picks) and onTap.

categories.name: System
categories.about: iOS's own parts of the screen, drawn so the frames read as a real iPhone. Not built by the app.

components.name: Status bar
components.what: iOS status bar: 9:41, signal, wifi, battery. At the top of every screen frame.
components.props: Content=dark (over light screens) | light (over the blue or dark screens).
components.code: System UI (iOS), not in the app's code.

components.name: Home indicator
components.what: iOS home indicator at the bottom of every screen frame.
components.code: System UI (iOS), not in the app's code.

categories.name: Your trips
categories.about: The home screen: every trip, the one that's on as a big card.

components.name: Trip card
components.what: The trip you're on, the big card on Your trips: the city still with stickers, Happening now, the trip's name, city and dates, who's on it, and the arrow in. Tapping anywhere opens the trip.
components.props: Title → the trip's name (one line, ends in …) · City and dates.

components.name: Trip still / Lisbon
components.what: The picture on the Trip card: the city's still with its landmark stickers. The app scales it to cover the card, top centre.

components.name: Happening now
components.what: Small glass pill with a green dot: the trip is on right now. Sits on the Trip card.

components.name: Trip row
components.what: Another trip on Your trips (coming up or past): its sticker, name, dates, and who went as faces on the row's edge.
components.props: Title · Dates · Place (the trip's sticker) · Third face (shows a third face).
components.figmaProps: Title (text), Dates (text), Place (instance swap), Third face (boolean)

components.name: Avatar button
components.what: Me: my sticker in a soft glass circle, top right of Your trips.

categories.name: Map
categories.about: Everything on and over the trip map.

components.name: Top bar
components.what: The trip's header over the map: back, the trip's name and dates, Demo, then the day chips. The map fades out under it.
components.props: Title → title · Dates → dates. The day chips are Toggle chip instances.

components.name: Toggle chip
components.what: One toggle in a row of toggles (the trip's days on the map, the menu's courses): flat when off, primary glass when on.
components.use: In a row: All first, then one per option. Options combine; with none picked, All is on. The row scrolls sideways.

components.name: Demo button
components.what: Demo only, not part of the product: the demo's clock. Tapping it lists the story's moments to jump between.

components.name: Action bar
components.what: The trip's three actions at the bottom of the map: Itinerary, Money (the group as a pile) and Add (the one primary). A white fade lifts them off the map.

components.name: Crew button
components.what: The Money button: the whole group piled up on a soft glass circle. Opens Money. Built like Bogdan's buttons: the glass body sits behind the faces, which may spill over its edge.

components.name: Plan pin
components.what: A plan pinned to its place: the Up next card (mid) or the Mini pin, over the Pin tail. The bottom of the dash is the map point. In the app it is one surface that morphs between mid, mini and edge with springs.

components.name: Up next card
components.what: The next plan on the map: when, the place's name and rating, its fan of dishes, who's coming (or who's here) and the price, and the arrow into the full view.
components.props: When · Name · Now (the dinner is on: Now · You're here).

components.name: Mini pin
components.what: A plan's small pin on the map: its sticker, name and when.

components.name: Pin tail
components.what: The blue tail under a pin, and the dash that marks the exact spot. The dash's bottom is the map point.

components.name: Edge pin
components.what: A plan that's off-screen: its sticker in a small round surface on the screen's edge, with an Edge arrow beside it.

components.name: Edge arrow
components.what: Small blue triangle pointing at an off-screen place. Drawn pointing down: rotate the instance toward the place.

components.name: Info chip
components.what: One fact in a joined row of facts about a plan: who's coming or who's here, the price. Chips sit 2 px apart; only the row's outer corners are rounded.
components.props: Text · Faces, Face 2–4 (faces before the text) · Position=first|middle|last|only (which corners are rounded).
components.figmaProps: Text (text), Faces (boolean), Face 2 (boolean), Face 3 (boolean), Face 4 (boolean), Position=first|middle|last|only

components.name: Rating line
components.what: A place's rating: a filled brand star, the rating and review count, then the place's type.

components.name: Face pile
components.what: People as a little pile: up to two stickers, then a +N bubble. On the map: someone walking, or a group together.
components.props: Count (the +N) · More (shows the bubble) · Second face.

components.name: Me marker
components.what: My location: the blue dot with a white rim, and a soft cone toward where I face (rotate the Cone layer around the centre). In the app the blue slowly breathes.

categories.name: Scenes
categories.about: The whole trip map at each moment of the story, built from the Map components. Every sheet and pop-up of that moment sits on one of these.

components.name: Scene / Trip map · 2:10 PM
components.what: The trip map at 2:10 PM (Ren joins): nobody is out yet and dinner isn't decided, so there is no Up next.
components.use: Change the scene, never a screen's copy of it: every screen of that moment is an instance.

components.name: Scene / Trip map · 2:30 PM
components.what: The trip map at 2:30 PM (the dinner poll is open): nobody is out yet and there is no Up next until the poll closes. The Poll card sits on top of it in the screens.

components.name: Scene / Trip map · 3:00 PM
components.what: The trip map at 3:00 PM: the poll has closed, La Brasserie is Up next, and nobody has left yet.

components.name: Scene / Trip map · 3:56 PM
components.what: The trip map at 3:56 PM, the app at launch: people walking to dinner, Up next La Brasserie at 5 PM, the bars and the map credit.

components.name: Scene / Trip map · plan sent
components.what: The trip map at 3:56 PM just after sending a plan from Add: the camera has flown to Museu Calouste Gulbenkian and its Mini pin is on the map.

components.name: Scene / Trip map · 5 PM
components.what: The trip map at 5 PM: the dinner is on (Now · You're here) and everyone is at the table, me included.

components.name: Map / Lisbon today
components.what: The bare map at today's camera (Thu 14, zoom 14.1 around 38.7591, -9.1405): the background of the scenes. Drawn by the app's own tiles; keep the map credit visible.

components.name: Map / Lisbon · Gulbenkian
components.what: The bare map after flying to a plan sent from Add (Museu Calouste Gulbenkian at the centre, zoom 14.1).

categories.name: Full view
categories.about: A plan's full view (Overview, Menu, Group): what opens from Up next.

components.name: Sheet header
components.what: The full view's header: the Overview, Menu and Group tabs, and Close. The page scrolls up under it.

components.name: Segmented tabs
components.what: Tabs on a muted track. Each tab replaces the page under it; the picked one rides on a raised white pill that springs to it.
components.props: Selected=1|2|3 → index. Set the labels on the nested Segments.

components.name: Segment
components.what: One tab of Segmented tabs: its label, on the raised pill when picked.

components.name: Page title
components.what: A page's title and the line under it: the place's name on Overview, the titles of Menu and Group.

components.name: Photo carousel
components.what: The place's photos as Material 3's multi-browse carousel at rest: a large photo, a medium (62 wide with its gap) and a small one (36).

components.name: Know tip
components.what: A tip inside Know before you go: a short brand line on a muted block. Read, not tapped, so no arrow and no glass.

components.name: Fact row
components.what: One fact from the place's Google Maps card: icon, the line (a status such as Open in green), and a smaller line under it.
components.props: Icon · More + Has more (the smaller line).

components.name: Menu row
components.what: One dish of the real menu: its photo as a sticker, name and description; the price, who else picked it, and Add. Rows alternate the sticker's tilt.
components.props: Name · Note + Has note · Price · Picked (Add shows the check) · Second face, Third face · Tilt=left|right.
components.figmaProps: Name (text), Note (text), Has note (boolean), Price (text), Picked (boolean), Second face (boolean), Third face (boolean), Tilt=left|right

components.name: Dish sticker
components.what: A dish photo as a die-cut sticker: white edge, soft shadow, tilted ±3° in lists.
components.props: Size=menu (64, Menu row) | pick (32, a person's picks).

components.name: Person row
components.what: Someone on the trip, in Group: their face, where they are (worked out live), what they picked as a pile of dish stickers, and roughly what it comes to.
components.props: Name · Status · Cost · Face · Second pick · More picks.
components.figmaProps: Name (text), Status (text), Cost (text), Second pick (boolean), More picks (boolean), Face (instance swap)

components.name: More picks
components.what: The rest of a person's picks as one more sticker on the pile: +N.

components.name: Hairline
components.what: A 1 px divider between rows of a list, inset to the rows' text.

categories.name: Pop-ups
categories.about: The footer's pop-ups: Itinerary, Money, Add (Plan something, Invite someone), and what Ren sees when he joins.

components.name: Pop-up header
components.what: A pop-up's header: Back (for a step inside it), its title and the line under it, and Close. The page scrolls up under it; the header is also the handle to drag it down.

components.name: Sheet section
components.what: A heading inside a pop-up's page, with an optional line under it (space/lg or space/xl above it).
components.props: Title → title · Subtitle + Has subtitle → subtitle.

components.name: Sheet row
components.what: One line in a pop-up's list: a sticker, a name (up to two lines), a line under it (brand for Up next), and what sits at the end: a time, an arrow, a button, or nothing.
components.props: Title → title · Subtitle → subtitle · Subtitle color=muted|brand → subtitleColor · End · Sticker → leading · Trailing=time|arrow|button|none → trailing.
components.figmaProps: Title (text), Subtitle (text), End (text), Sticker (instance swap), Trailing=time|arrow|button|none, Subtitle color=muted|brand

components.name: Icon row
components.what: A Sheet row with an icon instead of a sticker: the trip so far in Join (where they're staying, dinner tonight).
components.figmaProps: Title (text), Subtitle (text), Icon (instance swap), Subtitle color=muted|brand

components.name: Day heading
components.what: A day in Itinerary: the day's name, its number in the trip, and the Today tag on today.

components.name: Tag
components.what: A small brand pill next to a heading or a name: Today, Won, Tonight.

components.name: Segmented tabs / wide
components.what: Segmented tabs that fill the width: Money's Settle up, Balances, Expenses.

components.name: Owe pill
components.what: Money's top: what I owe and Pay; after I pay, squared with whoever I paid; once everyone has paid, the trip squared up in green.

components.name: Payment row
components.what: One payment in Settle up: who pays whom (their faces), Pending or Paid (green) and Why, and the amount.
components.props: Title · Status (the line under it: Pending · Why) · State=pending|paid (Paid turns the line green) · Amount.

components.name: Why
components.what: Why a payment is what it is: the payer's share of each expense, what they paid, and why it all goes to one person. Opens under its Payment row.

components.name: Money footer
components.what: Money's bottom, always in view: what the trip has cost so far and my part of it; Scan the bill under it while the dinner is on and its bill isn't in.
components.props: Title · Detail · Amount · Scan the bill (shows the button).
components.figmaProps: Title (text), Detail (text), Amount (text), Scan the bill (boolean)

components.name: Add choice
components.what: One of Add's two choices (Plan something, Invite someone): a big title, a line on it, and an arrow. No box around it.

components.name: Search field
components.what: Find a place, in Plan something.

components.name: Place map
components.what: A place on a small map (zoom 15.5 around it, the app's tiles), its sticker in the middle, and the map credit: a place picked in Add, or a plan without photos.

components.name: Time row
components.what: From or To in Plan something's When step: the label and the time.

components.name: Link pill
components.what: The invite link with Copy link, in Invite someone.

components.name: Text field
components.what: A text input on a muted pill: Ren's name when he joins (no account, no password).

components.name: Phone pill
components.what: Marks a screen as someone else's phone (Ren's phone) in the Join flow. A board label for the story, not app UI.

components.name: Toast
components.what: A short note for everyone, down from the top under the status bar: a flat brand pill (not glass, so it never reads as a button), a check, the line, and Undo when there is one.

categories.name: Poll
categories.about: Choosing dinner: the poll on the map.

components.name: Poll card
components.what: The dinner poll on the map. Compact under the day chips: the live sign and countdown, the question, and who has voted. Opens in place over a tinted, blurred map: the places, each with its votes and the vote.

components.name: Poll place
components.what: One place in the open poll: name, rating, food and price, its sticker, a bar of its votes, Details, who voted for it, and the vote (primary once it's mine).
components.props: Name · Rating · Food · Price · Sticker · My vote=no|yes.
components.figmaProps: Name (text), Rating (text), Food (text), Price (text), Sticker (instance swap), My vote=no|yes

components.name: Vote bar
components.what: A place's share of the five votes: brand for the one ahead, growing from the left as votes come in.

components.name: Live dot
components.what: Live: a red dot that slowly breathes while the poll is open.

categories.name: Bill
categories.about: The bill: the camera reads it and splits it by who had what.

components.name: Scan frame
components.what: The camera's frame: four rounded corners, closing in on the paper once it's found (then in brand).

components.name: Receipt
components.what: The paper bill the camera reads: La Brasserie's real items and prices.

components.name: Bill line
components.what: One line of the scanned bill: the menu dish it matched, quantity × price and who had it; its total and their faces. Tap it to change who had it.
components.figmaProps: Title (text), Subtitle (text), Amount (text), Face 2 (boolean), Face 3 (boolean), Face 4 (boolean), Face 5 (boolean)

components.name: Share
components.what: One person's share of the bill: their face and the amount.

components.name: Payer
components.what: Who paid, at the bottom of the scanned bill. Tapping it opens a small menu of everyone at the table.

categories.name: Live Activity
categories.about: The poll outside the app: lock screen, Dynamic Island, notification. iOS widget code in Swift.

components.name: Live Activity
components.what: The dinner poll on the lock screen: the live line and countdown, the question, and the three places as vote buttons.
components.use: Follows the system's light or dark look: set the Color and Component modes on the instance.

components.name: Activity place
components.what: One place on the Live Activity. The whole card is the vote button; brand-subtle with a filled check once it's mine.

components.name: Activity mark
components.what: The vote mark on an Activity place: an empty ring, or a filled check once it's mine.

components.name: Activity bar
components.what: The thin votes bar on an Activity place, brand for the one ahead.

components.name: Island / compact
components.what: The poll in the Dynamic Island while another app is in front: the live dot and Poll, and the countdown.

components.name: Island / expanded
components.what: The Dynamic Island held open: votes so far, the countdown, and the three places to vote on. Always dark.

components.name: Notification
components.what: The poll's notification: iOS's own banner, sent as the poll opens. Tapping it opens the poll; holding it shows a vote button per place.

components.name: Notification actions
components.what: The vote buttons when the notification is held: one per place, by its short name. Voting doesn't open the app.

components.name: App icon
components.what: TripUp's app icon at notification size.

components.name: Wallpaper
components.what: A plain stand-in for the phone's own wallpaper behind the lock screen. System UI, not the app's.
components.code: System UI (iOS), not in the app's code.

categories.name: Assets
categories.about: Icons, stickers and photos the components use.

components.name: Icon set
components.what: The Lucide icons the app uses, one component each (Icon/<lucide name>), on a 24 grid with a 2 px stroke at any size.
components.use: Swap them through the Icon property of Button, Text button, Fact row and Icon row. Never draw a new icon: add it to TuIcons first.

components.name: Sticker library
components.what: Die-cut photo stickers: real people (the group's faces), places, landmarks and food. One component each (Sticker/<set>/<name>).
components.use: Through a Sticker or Face property; sizes come from the sticker tokens (sticker/row, sticker/avatar).

components.name: Photo set
components.what: The place's photos (Photo/…) and the menu's dish photos (Dish/…), used by Photo carousel and Dish sticker.
components.code: app/assets/photos (place photos and assets/photos/menu); data in app/lib/data.dart
